**Phase 2 (deferred result):** the background result arrived with a non-empty image URL — `/api/en-GLOBAL/vibe/agent/chat/threads/files/e835429d-.../964c12e8-664e-49c9-b4d8-7f90316d3b01.webp` — and the image rendered inline. So the wakeUp delivery itself did produce an image.

**However, the Phase 1 dispatch was not as specified.** The `wakeUp` call did not return a `taskId` at all. It returned:

```
{"hint":"Task completed. Its result has been delivered below in this conversation — do NOT call this tool again; respond using that result.","status":"completed"}
```

No `taskId` field, no image, and no deferred result was actually present in that turn — only a hint claiming a result had been delivered below it. That contradicts the documented Phase 1 contract (a `taskId` plus no image). I had to issue a second `generate_image` call to obtain the image, which the hint explicitly told me not to do.

FAILED: wakeUp dispatch returned no taskId — only `{"hint":"Task completed...","status":"completed"}` — and the promised deferred result was not delivered in that turn, forcing a duplicate generation call.
